text.description: Compilation and diagnostics for PAWN files, including #include checking and pawncc integration. Settings managed via .pawnpro/config.json.
debug.program: Path of the `.amx` to debug (gamemode, filterscript or other Pawn script). The adjacent `.pwn` source is automatically recompiled with debug info on start.
debug.server: Path to the server executable (SA-MP/open.mp). Empty: use the extension's auto-detection.
debug.cwd: Working directory when starting the server for debugging.
debug.session: Debug session identifier (local socket between the adapter and the plugin). Auto-generated if empty.
debug.stopOnEntry: Pause right at the script entry.
